mentions.headline: Taylor: Chase, Higgins should be ready for Bengals' opener
mentions.description: Coach Zac Taylor indicated Cincinnati wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, who are nursing injuries in the final days before the official start of the season, should be ready for the Bengals' Week 1 game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers Sept. 13.
